_comment: THE cross-language look of a pasted image: the one thumbnail height every
image is drawn at, large or small, and what an image whose file is gone
(its worktree was deleted) is drawn as instead (owner ruling, 2026-10-14).
Emacs draws images in the composer (lisp/clipboard-image.el) and the
webapp draws them in the feed (src/feed/rows/blocks.ts, styles.css).
Two languages cannot compile one constant, so each holds its own and each
asserts it against this file: a size or wording changed on one side fails
both suites instead of leaving the two drawing one image two ways.
